## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Architectural & Privacy Considerations
Does this feature align with Anomoly Chat's core values?
- [ ] Preserves accountless anonymity (no emails, phone numbers, or passwords)
- [ ] Zero server message persistence (no central database storing messages/files)
- [ ] Maintains truthful privacy claims as outlined in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)

Add any other context, wireframes, or screenshots about the feature request here.
